DataType.Name: GEN_kW_Data
DataType.Content: TYPE GEN_kW_Data : STRUCT Present_P :REAL; (* Measured kW*) Op_Enabled :BOOL; (* Enable/Disable kW Control from PMS HMI *) Ctrl_Mode :BOOL; (* Current Control Mode Maintain or Regulation*) Op_Ctrl_Mode :BOOL; (* Current Control Mode Maintain or Regulation*) Op_Set :REAL; (*kW base set point entered by user*) Up_Limit :REAL; (*kW Upper limit*) Low_Limit :REAL; (*kW Lower limit*) Gen_Mode :BOOL; (*Gen Operation Mode Droop/ISO*) Request_Set :REAL; (*Set Point calculated by GCS*) Bus_Conn :STRING; (*Gen Bus Connection*) Brkr_Status :BOOL; (*Gen Brkr Status*) Remote_En :BOOL; (*Gen is in Remote Mode*) Out_of_Band :BOOL; (*Gen Operating within Band*) Max_Capacity :BOOL; (*Gen reaches kW Max Capacity*) Follow_Error :BOOL; (*Excepted Repondes not observerd*) Gov_Not_Respond :BOOL; (*Governor not acknowledge AGC Control*) Run_Perm :BOOL; (*Overall AGC healthy*) END_STRUCT END_TYPE
